gen-gf-baumans-gf-trirong: Commanding and distinctive, Baumans draws its curves flat, with no swelling at all. Trirong follows in a bookish serif, its crossbars a touch slimmer than the stems, giving the page a dignified counterweight.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-trocchi: Baumans looks like neon glass tubing, with a crescent-wrench c, while Trocchi's serif bowls thin out gracefully below it. One hums, the other breathes.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-trykker: Flat, contrast-free letters like cut-out signage lead in Baumans, set above a Trykker serif whose thick-thin difference stays mellow. Paragraphs unspool gently, with space around every letter.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-uchen: Baumans glides like wire, every stroke unvarying. Uchen's serif joins slim noticeably yet stay sturdy, so the pair's strongest quality is how a stark heading hands off to a body that feels welcoming.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-vollkorn-sc: Baumans holds one steady weight, its c opened like a wrench. If that heading shrank, its stroke would lose authority, while Vollkorn SC, a serif with loose tracking and slightly receding light strokes, would feel too slack when enlarged.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-yuji-syuku: Authoritative marker-nib strokes define Baumans. The heading font excels at bold, direction-ignoring statements, whereas Yuji Syuku, a text serif, does its best work narrowing gradually from stem to terminal across generously spaced glyphs.
gen-gf-baumans-ibm-plex-serif: Baumans stitches its strokes like thread along a path, each c opened wide. IBM Plex Serif follows in moderately modulated lines, so extended reading moves along with a corporate steadiness.
gen-gf-bellota-crimson-pro: Crimson Pro reads as a refined text serif, packed close, with a subtle thick-thin cadence running through every line. Beneath Bellota's neon-tube letters, paragraphs feel settled and quietly classic.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-neco: Neco brings a dignified text serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, never pinching its letters shut. Under Bellota's one-width pen line, longer reading stays open and authoritative.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-recia: Recia is a sharp serif, its modulation visible mainly up close, with generous openings at every weight. And Bellota's spaghetti-like strokes, hanging s ends included, give it a distinctive, commanding lead.
